svg.title: Enterprise Data Platform — Repository Structure
svg.desc: Monorepo layout showing top-level modules: ingestion, transformation, quality, orchestration, governance, catalog, devsecops, dl_monitor, logger, and event_trigger
svg.text: Unit tests (pytest + moto S3 mock) · Integration tests · dbt unit tests · Spark test base
Lint · SAST · Secret scan · Unit tests · IaC (Terraform + Terragrunt) · Auto-deploy per env
Config-driven design: Pipfile · Dockerfile · values.yaml · .conf per env (dev / qa / uat / prod)
All secrets via AWS Secrets Manager · PII flag in pipeline config
